edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the stored gov address in the onlyGov modifier
rebase() gates on msg.sender == tx.origin, granting any EOA entry to a supply-changing routine
tx.origin is used as the only caller filter in rebase(), enabling phishing-style bypass of intended restrictions
rebase() window and interval checks depend entirely on block.timestamp
getTWAP derives timeElapsed from the miner-controlled block timestamp, so the oracle price is timestamp dependent
activate_rebasing uses now against MIN_TIME_FIRST_REBASE and rebaseDelay
_acceptGov reads pendingGov to authorize the governance transfer
_acceptGov requires msg.sender == pendingGov before promoting gov
rebase() invokes afterRebase(mintAmount, offPegPerc) after mutating the token supply
rebase() reads the TWAP exchange rate from getTWAP to size indexDelta
rebase() calls yam.rebase and yam.yamsScalingFactor on the external token before later actions complete
afterRebase calls buyReserveAndTransfer when mintAmount > 0
afterRebase iterates over stored transactions and arbitrary-calls each destination before the rebase state is fully settled
externalCall performs an assembly call forwarding remaining gas to an attacker-influenced destination
buyReserveAndTransfer triggers pair.swap which hands control to the Uniswap pair and back into the callback
The Uniswap pair re-enters the contract through uniswapV2Call with data controlled by the caller
uniswapV2Call forwards reserve tokens to the reserves contract and public goods address via SafeERC20
uniswapV2Call mints YAM to the pair and reserves contract through the token interface
The mintAmount argument determines how much YAM is offered in the swap
offPegPerc selects the slippage cap path inside buyReserveAndTransfer
tokens_to_max_slippage, derived from reserves and offPegPerc, drives the swap branch selection
The encoded UniVars struct is passed as swap data and later decoded in the callback
afterRebase reads the gov-configured transactions array to execute follow-up calls
externalCall receives destination and calldata taken from the stored transactions array
destination parameter flows into the low-level call target
data parameter flows into the low-level call payload
afterRebase iterates uniSyncPairs and calls sync on each pair
afterRebase iterates balGulpPairs and calls gulp on each Balancer pool
getTWAP queries the stored Uniswap pair for cumulative prices and reserves
buyReserveAndTransfer instantiates the Uniswap pair to fetch reserves and perform the swap
uniswapV2Call pulls YAM from and mints YAM to the reserves contract
uniswapV2Call uses yamAddress to build the YAMTokenInterface for mint/transferFrom
isToken0 chooses whether amount0 or amount1 is treated as the reserve token proceeds
_inRebaseWindow requires rebasingActive before rebase() can proceed
rebase() checks and rewrites lastRebaseTimestampSec against the minimum interval
getTWAP subtracts the stored blockTimestampLast from the current timestamp
rescueTokens passes the token parameter into SafeERC20.safeTransfer
rescueTokens passes the recipient parameter into SafeERC20.safeTransfer
rescueTokens passes the amount parameter into SafeERC20.safeTransfer
rescueTokens performs an outbound token transfer that can move any balance held by the contract
rescueTokens is protected by onlyGov, so msg.sender must equal gov
buyReserveAndTransfer computes tokens_to_max_slippage - excess with raw unchecked arithmetic
The unchecked subtraction result is written into uniVars.mintToReserves, which can underflow and mint unexpected amounts
getTWAP relies on intentional uint32/uint wrapping for timeElapsed and cumulative price deltas
Wrapped cumulative price values feed priceAverage, which then scales the reported TWAP
uniswapV2Call validates the sender argument against address(this) before proceeding
uniswapV2Call restricts execution to calls originating from the configured uniswap_pair
_acceptGov overwrites gov with pendingGov, completing the privilege transfer
_acceptGov resets pendingGov to address(0) after the handover

normalization_plan.reason: sender is only used to validate the caller of the callback, so it collapses into the uniswapV2Call core function
amount0 is transient callback bookkeeping used only for the reserve token transfer branch
amount1 is transient callback bookkeeping used only for the reserve token transfer branch
the abi-encoded UniVars payload is decoded immediately and has no meaning outside the callback
mintAmount only parameterizes the slippage-capped swap sizing logic
offPegPerc only selects the slippage heuristic branch in uniswapMaxSlippage
destination is consumed solely as the low-level call target inside externalCall
calldata is consumed solely as the low-level call payload inside externalCall
token only identifies the ERC20 forwarded by the rescue transfer
to only identifies the recipient of the rescue transfer
amount only sizes the rescue transfer
exchangeRate is a transient TWAP read used only to compute the supply delta inside rebase
indexDelta is an intermediate dampened delta local to the rebase computation
mintAmount is the local treasury mint figure produced and forwarded by rebase
timeElapsed is an intermediate timestamp delta used only within the TWAP computation
priceAverage is an intermediate value converted into the returned TWAP
uniVars is the struct assembled in buyReserveAndTransfer and ABI-encoded into the swap call
excess is the reserves-contract YAM balance read only to size the swap
tokens_to_max_slippage is the slippage-capped amount local to the swap sizing logic
amount_to_public_goods is computed and immediately spent inside the callback's transfer branch
